ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَيِّدْنَا بِالْكَرَامَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ayyidnā bi ‘l-karāmāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and assist us with Miracles.

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَجَمِّلْنَا بِجَمِيْلِ الصِّفَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa jammil nā bi jamīli ‘ṣ-ṣifāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and beautify us with beautiful traits!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَزِلْ عَنْ قُلُوْبِنَا حُبَّ الرِّئَاسَةِ وَجَمِيْعَ الشَّهَوَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa azil `an qulūbinā ḥubba ‘r-ri’āsati wa jamī`a ‘sh-shahawāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and remove from our hearts the love of Mastership and all base desires!
